insult: Thou art a boil, a plague-sore, an embossed carbuncle in corrupted flesh.
Thou clay-brained guts, thou knotty-pated fool!
Away, you masterless hairy man! You are a boil, a plague-sore, an embossed carbuncle.
Thou foul ulcer, festering greasy swamp! I am better than thee in nothing but loose behavior.
Away, you scullion! You are a very rag of intestine! You reek of brackishness.
Thou art a raging ape, a sweating bog! Your face is food for powder, your wit a fustian fan.
Away, you whoreson mandrake! You are a boil, a plague-sore, an embossed carbuncle.
Thou reekest of stale stinking farts. Your brain is a parchment whereon no wit is written.
Away, you moldy rogue! You are a knot of nakedness, a boil, a plague-sore.
Thou art a ragged rascal! A boil, a plague-sore, an embossed carbuncle! You are the plague's herald.
Away, you whoreson gorbellied knave! Your guts are a coil of ropiness.
Thou art a boil, a plague-sore, an embossed carbuncle in the infected flesh of the world.
Away, you base insect! You are a boil, a plague-sore, a thing of stinking corruption.
Thou clay-brained rascal! A boil, a plague-sore, a festering worm.
Away, you leprous slave! You are a boil, a corruption, a walking ulcer.
Thou art a flesh-monger, a fool and a coward, a very weasel of perfume.
Away, you beslubbering, onion-eyed, flap-mouthed varlet!
Thou art a boil, a plague-sore, a carbuncle, canker'd and full of pus.
You are a gorbellied flap-dragon, a swallow of sack and a spitter of gall.
Away, you hedge-born raskall! You are the very cream of cutpurses.
Thou art a pribbling ill-nurtured maggot-pie, fit only for the gallows.
You are a bawdy, unfit, lean-fac'd villain, a canker-blossom.
Thou art a base, proud, shallow, beggarly, three-suited, hundred-pound, filthy worsted-stocking knave.
Away, you scurvy companion! You have no more brain than a goose.
Thou art a rogue, a rascal, a cookie-conjurer, a darned-ticket.
You are a whoreson leather-jerkin, a castle-badger, a buff-jerk.
Thou art an eldest son of livery, a follower of musty news.
Away, you knot of madness! You are a very disease of speech.
Thou art a most notable coward, an infinite and endless liar, a promise-breaker.
You are a saucy, roguish, rascally, beggarly, base, crooked-kneed, lily-livered knave.
Thou art a fusty nut with no kernel, a husk without corn.
Away, you beslubbering, fustilarian, miscreant!
Thou art a bawdy, unfit, lean-fac'd villain, a canker-blossom, a weed of the field.

Thou art a fool, a coxcomb, a very Jack-a-Lent, a fool's errand.
